description: Codex: Orks (11e) FLYIN' HEADBUTT (Flyboyz, 1 CP, either player's turn, any phase) in the ENEMY's Shooting phase through the real unit_destroyed window, which opens BEFORE Deadly Demise is rolled (design §3). Fixture ork11e_orks_reactive: P1 Custodes active, P2 Orks. Setup privileges: P2's detachment is switched to Flyboyz; the Dakkajet (ORKS AIRCRAFT, Deadly Demise D3) and Custodian Guard F are placed 10" apart in the open; the jet is left on 1 wound at T2 with no save so one volley destroys it; both players have 4 CP. The Custodes shoot with the phase action their AI sends (atomic SHOOT, all ranged weapons at the Dakkajet). The jet is destroyed: its Deadly Demise is HELD and the unit_destroyed window opens for PLAYER 2 (the owner, non-active): the StratagemDialog offers FLYIN' HEADBUTT on the destroyed Dakkajet with an enabled Use button while the hot-seat overlay names Player 2. A real click on Use opens the enemy-unit pick (enemy units within 12" of the wreck); a real click on Custodian Guard F spends 1 CP, rolls eight D6 (each 4+ = 1 mortal wound to Custodian Guard F) and the Dakkajet loses Deadly Demise — the held roll is released and skipped.

steps.comment: the Custodes' shooting: the atomic SHOOT action (all ranged weapons at the Dakkajet)
Deadly Demise is held until the window closes
the Custodes' phase waits for the Ork player's decision
one mortal wound per 4+, all on Custodian Guard F (5 x W4 = 20 wounds before)
the held Deadly Demise was released — and skipped (no ability)
